thread:
elaine: Opening a small PR to tighten Private installer networking docs for on-prem HSMs. Current blanket MASQUERADE hides source IP and breaks HSM audit logs. Need a quick review.

marc: paste the exact snippets you plan to add so infra can sanity-check.

elaine: iptables (exempt HSM subnet): ```sh
# place RETURN before MASQUERADE to exempt HSM subnet
iptables -t nat -I POSTROUTING 1 -s 10.100.0.0/16 -d 172.22.88.0/24 -j RETURN
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -m comment --comment "egress" -j MASQUERADE
``` nftables alternative: ```nft
table ip nat {
  chain postrouting {
    type nat hook postrouting priority 100;
    ip saddr 10.100.0.0/16 ip daddr 172.22.88.0/24 accept;
    oifname "eth0" masquerade
  }
}
```

sara: please add a preflight checklist (ip_forward, route to HSM, clock sync) and a short SDK example showing TLS client certs. Ops prefer Go.

elaine: added preflight: ```sh
sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward || echo "ERROR: ip_forward disabled"
ip route get 172.22.88.10 || echo "WARN: no route to HSM"
date -u; timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized || echo "WARN: clock unsynced"
``` and Go SDK snippet: ```go
client, _ := redwood.NewPrivateClient(redwood.ClientOptions{
  KMSEndpoint: "https://kms.local:8443",
  client_cert: "/etc/pki/client.crt",
  client_key:  "/etc/pki/client.key",
  ca_cert:     "/etc/pki/ca.crt",
})
_ = client.Healthcheck()
```

marc: also include a tiny netns test script so engineers can validate behavior locally and change wording to "preserve source IP for HSM audit logs" per compliance.

elaine: added test-hsm-netns.sh to the PR and updated wording. Replaced the broken HSM link with /integrations/hsm/pkcs11/. Also added a compact ASCII packet-flow line for quick orientation:

Host(10.100.0.2) -> Gateway (masq except HSM subnet) -> HSM(172.22.88.10)
